'''2011 German National Championship Stefaan Lambrecht DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stefaan Lambrecht]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
